venira.avoid_when: tiny single-file edits or states git already holds.
venira.output_kind: create: id, file_count, total_bytes, truncated, skipped[]. restore: restored[], deleted_count, skipped[].
venira.speed_profile: create walks/hashes the captured files (skips .git/node_modules/dist, symlinks, huge files); repeats only store new blobs. restore is atomic per file, concurrency 4, SHA-256 verified by default; dry_run previews path/size only, not same-size content changes.
venira.use_when: before multi-file refactors or overwriting/deleting files git does not hold. Keep paths narrow and check file_count and skipped. Roll back with restore dry_run=1, then restore with verify=1.

description:
Checkpoint and roll back workspace files. action: create (label, paths) | list | restore (id) | delete (id) | mirror (copy to VENIRA_SNAPSHOT_MIRROR_DIR).
Use when: before multi-file refactors or overwriting/deleting files git does not hold. Keep paths narrow and check file_count and skipped. Roll back with restore dry_run=1, then restore with verify=1.
Avoid when: tiny single-file edits or states git already holds.
Output: create: id, file_count, total_bytes, truncated, skipped[]. restore: restored[], deleted_count, skipped[].

action.description: create (default) captures paths; list; restore rolls back an id; delete removes an id; mirror copies the store to VENIRA_SNAPSHOT_MIRROR_DIR.

delete_extra.description: restore only: 1 also deletes files in captured dirs that are not in the checkpoint (max 500). Default 0; use only when intended.

dry_run.description: restore only: 1 previews path/size changes without writing.

id.description: Checkpoint id (required for restore/delete; returned by create/list).

label.description: Human label for the checkpoint, e.g. "before refactor auth".

limit.description: list only: max checkpoints to return (default 20).

max_total_bytes.description: Max total bytes captured (default and max 512 MiB).

paths.description: Workspace-relative paths to capture (default ['.'] = whole workspace; scope narrowly). For restore: subset to restore.

reason.description: Optional why (max 400 chars), audit-logged. Required only on project_ci_control.

respect_default_excludes.description: 1 skips standard generated/cache directories (default); 0 disables those exclusions.

verify.description: restore: 1 verifies each blob before writing (default). mirror: 1 re-hashes blobs already at the mirror and re-copies bad ones (default 0).

name: project_snapshot
title: Workspace checkpoint
